slice: zero-model worker tool mounting diagnosis and host-invocable diagnostic tool
purpose: Add a zero-model probe that creates and immediately releases one restricted worker Session to prove the mounted tool surface, and expose it through a separate diagnostic tool so the fixed host can run the probe without a model call or a business task.

implementation.probe: WorkerSessionDriver.probeEventTools() shares mountRestrictedSurface() with the real worker compose path; it creates one dedicated shiyu-worker-probe-<uuid> Session with a fixed placeholder task tool plus the attached event tool source, reads the actually assembled tools (name/description/parameter summary/source), recursively rejects authority field names (actor/permit/scope/taskId/assignmentId/principalId/authorization/ownerId/budget), detects model activity through session/event + agent/request + llm/stream and requires all counters to be 0, cancels and disposes late handles, and fails explicitly (no retry) on creation/source/malformed-tool/model-activity/release errors.
implementation.runtime: runtime.probe-event-tools is an owner/local-control zero-model read-only command with the same admission semantics as session.probe (refused while globally paused, shared operation slot, abortable, no retry); the receipt is cached in snapshot().diagnostics.eventToolProbe and nothing is published or written to business tables.
implementation.leadTool: index.ts exports the status and diagnosis tool definitions for unit testing and registers shiyu_diagnose_worker_tools (parameterless, non-concurrency-safe) which executes exactly that command; the description states zero-model diagnosis, no task execution, no sending and no business writes.
implementation.tests: 6 probe tests (positive assembly/authority fields/no model events/does not disturb a later real run/source missing or malformed/creation-release-request failures/abort and late handle/model activity injection) + 3 runtime probe tests + 2 tool-definition tests.

verification.expectedHostReceipt: ok=true; tools exactly [shiyu_worker_probe_task, shiyu_worker_event_types, shiyu_worker_event_report]; assignment/event tools separated; authorityFields=[]; counters all 0; released/disposed true; probeSessionId prefix shiyu-worker-probe-; no business Task/Goal/Lab/event/delivery change.
verification.limitations: The probe proves restricted mounting, non-forgeable fields and release only. It cannot prove a model actually called a tool, provider budgets, or core native continuation dispatch; those remain G4/H2c gaps.
